gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-radio-canada: Spaghetti-thin loops, loud and bold. Radio Canada follows in the body with tall, full-bodied lowercase and a steady stroke, giving Funnel Display's wild lines something level to lean on.
gen-flavors-gf-open-sans: Flavors has a towering x-height, like a stubby carpenter's pencil. Open Sans sits below in bulky, smooth lowercase, and its size can be nudged up a touch so the two stay in step.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-parkinsans: Autour One cuts a clear channel into every round letter, with no hairline thinning anywhere. Parkinsans takes the same stroke thickness all the way through, and its wide mouths stay crisp even when shrunk.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Expressive and a little rough, Unkempt keeps its gaps so c never collapses into o. Be Vietnam Pro brings a high mean line and curves that never crowd their own endings, which gives the pair its strongest quality.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-devanagari: Commanding from the first glance, Wallpoet rises high and lets the paper show through its lines, while Anek Devanagari is the one that earns its keep with distinctly open mouths and a tall middle zone.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-gujarati: Wallpoet climbs high with smooth bends and gaps of paper running through every line. Anek Gujarati keeps lowercase nearly the height of the capitals with a gaping c, so it holds up fine at a modest size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-latin: Tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals gives Anek Latin a held-open, uncurled reading feel. And Wallpoet takes the loud work, with its high-rising letters and see-through lines, while the body just keeps reading smooth.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-tamil: Wallpoet comes in stencil-cut and bold, rising high. Anek Tamil then carries a longer passage with big round bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes, so the text feels open and easy to move through.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-telugu: Stencil swagger meets soft roundness here. Wallpoet is best at making a loud, high-rising statement, but Anek Telugu does the quieter job, its wide, tall bowls staying unlatched like an open hook.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anuphan: Wallpoet rises high, with paper showing between its letters. Anuphan does the steadier work, using big round bowls and open curves with clear gaps while the heading handles the shouting.
